				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-67ad591b e-transform e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="67ad591b" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;,&quot;_transform_translateX_effect&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_laptop&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateX_effect_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_laptop&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_tablet&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]},&quot;_transform_translateY_effect_mobile&quot;:{&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;sizes&quot;:[]}}">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-6fec4f0a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="6fec4f0a" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4f0b3e6a elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="4f0b3e6a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h1 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Kurs Kitesurfing</h1>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-67bf1ec0 elementor-widget-divider--separator-type-pattern elementor-widget-divider--no-spacing elementor-widget-divider--view-line elementor-widget elementor-widget-divider" data-id="67bf1ec0" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="divider.default">
							<div class="elementor-divider">
			<span class="elementor-divider-separator">
						</span>
		</div>
						</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-276ced34 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="276ced34" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Indywidualne i grupowe zajęcia kitesurfingu na każdym poziomie zaawansowania – od pierwszego startu po progres tricków. Ucz się z najlepszymi instruktorami w sercu Półwyspu Helskiego.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2bc2afa6 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="2bc2afa6" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-63064b58 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="63064b58" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1a911f7c elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="1a911f7c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Poczuj wolność na wodzie z każdym podmuchem wiatru</h2>				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-23ecc909 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="23ecc909" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>Zajęcia prowadzimy na czterech poziomach zaawansowania – od podstaw po zaawansowany freestyle – zgodnie ze standardami PZKite (Polski Związek Kitesurfingu).</p><h6><span><strong>W trakcie lekcji wykorzystujemy łączność radiową, co umożliwia stałą komunikację między kursantem a instruktorem.</strong></span></h6>								</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c49e18 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c49e18" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">

					<h3 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">Poznaj 4 poziomy Kursu Kitesurfingu</h3>				</div>

									<p>Kitesurfing to sport pełen zmiennych — zależny od pogody, spotu i detali. Nie warto się spieszyć.​ Z nami nie tylko nauczysz się pływać, ale znajdziesz przyjaciół i wsparcie.</p>								</div>

									<p>min. 4h — zasady bezpieczeństwa, sterowanie latawcem, pierwsze ćwiczenia w wodzie (bodydrag).</p>								</div>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-19744362 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="19744362" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
									<p>min. 6h (polecamy 10h) — start z deską (waterstart), pierwsze ślizgi, kontrola na wodzie.</p>								</div>
